name: kwong-stack-agents
description: 33 specialist Claude Code agents across 8 engineering domains: Web Stack (data, security, ai-llm, application, infrastructure, observability, presentation), Game Design (game-design, narrative, level-design, game-ux, game-tech, production), GitHub (gh-repo, gh-actions, gh-issues, gh-prs, gh-releases, gh-docs), Quality (web-qa, accessibility, performance, game-qa), Research (user-research, usability-testing, focus-group, expert-review), Product (product, analytics), Cross-cutting (i18n, finops), and Meta (sprint-assembler, project-setup). Includes opinionated /audit checklists, /scaffold templates, and /advise mode per agent. Master orchestrator routes all requests in dependency order.
